def report_metadata() -> int:
    sys.stderr.write(json.dumps({"adapter": ADAPTER_SHA, "pins": PINS_SHA, "snapshot": SNAPSHOT_SHA, "input": INPUT_SHA}) + "\n")
    return 30


def load_source13():
    raw = ADAPTER_PATH.read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != ADAPTER_SHA:
        raise SystemExit(31)
    module = types.ModuleType(ADAPTER_NAME)
    module.__file__ = str(ADAPTER_PATH)
    module.__name__ = ADAPTER_NAME
    exec(compile(raw, str(ADAPTER_PATH), "exec"), module.__dict__)
    if module.__name__ == "__main__" or module.HERE != ADAPTER_PATH.parent:
        raise SystemExit(31)
    if module.DEFAULT_PINS != ADAPTER_PATH.parent / "k-macro05-trace106-pins.json":
        raise SystemExit(31)
    return module


def selected(pins: dict, role: str) -> dict:
    return next(item for item in pins["selectedExecutables"] if item["role"] == role)


def bind_pins(module):
    pins_path = module.DEFAULT_PINS
    if hashlib.sha256(pins_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != PINS_SHA:
        raise SystemExit(31)
    pins = module.load_pins(pins_path)
    if pins["manifests"].get("snapshotSHA256") != SNAPSHOT_SHA:
        raise SystemExit(31)
    for role in ("python3.14", "strace", "bwrap", "java"):
        item = selected(pins, role)
        digest = hashlib.sha256(Path(item["path"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        if digest != item["sha256"]:
            raise SystemExit(31)
    if selected(pins, "python3.14")["path"] != PYTHON or selected(pins, "bwrap")["path"] != BWRAP:
        raise SystemExit(31)
    if selected(pins, "strace")["path"] != pins["diagnosticArgv"][0]:
        raise SystemExit(31)
    return pins

        "O=%d;H=%r;C=%r;J=%r;K=%s;B=%r;S=%r;L=%r;I=%r\n"

        "status=pathlib.Path('/proc/self/status').read_text().splitlines()\n"
        "caps={l.split(':')[0]:l.split(':',1)[1].strip() for l in status if l.startswith('Cap')}\n"
        "if any(int(caps.get(k,'1'),16)!=0 for k in %s): fail(33)\n"
        "cg=next(x.split(':',2)[2] for x in pathlib.Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().splitlines() if x.startswith('0::'))\n"
        "if not cg.endswith('/'+L) or cg.rstrip('/').split('/')[-1]!=L: fail(33)\n"
        "root=pathlib.Path('/sys/fs/cgroup')/cg.lstrip('/')\n"
        "def rd(n): return (root/n).read_text().strip()\n"
        "if rd('memory.max')!='8589934592' or rd('memory.swap.max')!='0' or rd('cpu.max')!='200000 100000': fail(33)\n"
        "_ = rd('memory.events')\n"
        "leaf_m=8589934592\n"
        "p=root.parent\n"
        "while p!=p.parent and str(p)!='/sys/fs/cgroup':\n"
        "    mp=p/'memory.max'\n"
        "    if mp.is_file():\n"
        "        v=mp.read_text().strip()\n"
        "        if v!='max' and int(v)<0: fail(33)\n"
        "    p=p.parent\n"
        "now=time.monotonic_ns()\n"
        "if now<O or now-O>5000000000 or (O+50000000000)-now<25000000000: fail(34)\n"
        "raw=base64.b64decode(B)\n"
        "if len(raw)!=13830 or hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()!=S: fail(35)\n"
        "fd=os.open(I, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL, 0o600)\n"
        "try:\n"
        "    n=os.write(fd, raw)\n"

        "caps={l.split(':')[0]:l.split(':',1)[1].strip() for l in status if l.startswith('Cap')}\n"
        "if any(int(caps.get(k,'1'),16)!=0 for k in %s): fail(33)\n"
        "now=time.monotonic_ns()\n"
        "if (O+50000000000)-now<25000000000: fail(34)\n"
        "import subprocess\n"
        "java=subprocess.run([J,'-XshowSettings:properties','-version'],stdout=sys.stderr)\n"
        "if java.returncode<0: fail(37)\n"
        "if java.returncode!=0: fail(36)\n"
        "marker('pre-krun')\n"
        "k=subprocess.run(K)\n"

def check_outer_identity() -> None:
    if os.getuid() != 1000 or os.getgid() != 1000 or os.getcwd() != CWD:
        raise SystemExit(32)
    origin = os.environ.get(ORIGIN_ENV, "")
    if type(origin) is not str or not origin.isdigit():
        raise SystemExit(34)
    origin_ns = int(origin)
    now = time.monotonic_ns()
    if origin_ns > now or now - origin_ns > 5_000_000_000:
        raise SystemExit(34)
    text = Path("/proc/self/cgroup").read_text()
    cg = next(line.split(":", 2)[2] for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith("0::"))
    if not cg.endswith("/" + SCOPE_LEAF) or cg.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1] != SCOPE_LEAF:
        raise SystemExit(33)
    root = Path("/sys/fs/cgroup") / cg.lstrip("/")
    if (root / "memory.max").read_text().strip() != "8589934592":
        raise SystemExit(33)
    if (root / "memory.swap.max").read_text().strip() != "0":
        raise SystemExit(33)
    if (root / "cpu.max").read_text().strip() != "200000 100000":
        raise SystemExit(33)
    (root / "memory.events").read_text()
    caps = {}
    for line in Path("/proc/self/status").read_text().splitlines():
        if line.startswith("Cap"):
            caps[line.split(":")[0]] = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
    if any(int(caps.get(key, "1"), 16) != 0 for key in CAP_KEYS):
        raise SystemExit(33)
    return origin_ns


def replace_workload(argv: list[str], pins: dict, origin_ns: int) -> list[str]:
    diagnostic = list(pins["diagnosticArgv"])
    k = len(argv) - len(diagnostic) - 1
    if k < 1 or argv[0] != BWRAP or argv[k] != "--" or "--" in argv[:k] or argv[k + 1:] != diagnostic:
        raise SystemExit(31)
    trace = next(item["path"] for item in pins["retained"] if item["role"] == "input")
    recorded = list(pins["recordedArgv"])
    recorded[1] = CANARY
    inner = inner_program(origin_ns, selected(pins, "java")["path"], recorded)
    suffix = list(diagnostic[:8]) + [PYTHON, "-I", "-B", "-c", inner]
    if suffix == diagnostic or trace in suffix:
        raise SystemExit(31)
    if suffix.count("--") != 1 or argv[: k + 1].count("--") != 1:
        raise SystemExit(31)
    return list(argv[: k + 1]) + suffix


def make_exec_callback(pins: dict, origin_ns: int):
    def execve(path, argv, env):
        try:
            if path != BWRAP:
                os._exit(31)
            replaced = replace_workload(list(argv), pins, origin_ns)
            os.execve(path, replaced, env)
            os._exit(38)
        except SystemExit as exc:
            code = exc.code if type(exc.code) is int else 38
            os._exit(code if code else 38)
        except Exception:
            os._exit(38)
    return execve


def run_smoke() -> int:
    try:
        origin_ns = check_outer_identity()
        adapter = load_source13()
        pins = bind_pins(adapter)
        callback = make_exec_callback(pins, origin_ns)
        result = adapter.run_shim(pins=pins, execve=callback, home=HOME)
        return 38 if result is not None else 38
    except SystemExit as exc:
        code = exc.code if type(exc.code) is int else 39
        return 31 if code == 0 else code
    except adapter_error():
        return 31
    except Exception:
        return 39


def adapter_error():
    try:
        adapter = load_source13()
        return adapter.PreflightError
    except Exception:
        return tuple()


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    args = list(sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv)
    if args:
        return 31
    try:
        return run_smoke()
    except Exception:
        return 39


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
